nodes.description: Private counter of the last minted token id, drives minting and the Tesla lottery.
Maximum token supply (7777) used as mint cap and lottery modulus.
Owner-controlled base URI prefix concatenated in tokenURI.
Fixed mint price of 0.042 ether checked in buy().
Sale start timestamp, initialized with block.timestamp and owner-settable.
Address selected as Tesla winner by the pseudo-random lottery.
Contract owner address used by onlyOwner guards.
Per-user meta transaction nonce mapping to prevent signature replay.
Mapping token id to owner, mutated by mint/transfer.
Mapping owner to token balance, mutated by mint/burn/transfer.
One-shot initialization flag guarding initializer modifier.
Owner-only setter that overwrites the sale start timestamp.
Owner-only privileged mint to an arbitrary address.
Payable public mint gated by startTime, price and supply cap.
Owner-only function transferring the whole contract balance to the owner.
Private helper returning _currentTokenId + 1 via SafeMath.add.
Internal pseudo-random generator hashing block.coinbase, block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Private incrementer that also runs the Tesla lottery when supply is nearly reached.
Owner-only setter of the base token URI.
Public view concatenating baseTokenURI with the token id string.
Overridden sender resolution delegating to ContextMixin.msgSender for meta transactions.
Public payable meta transaction executor verifying a signature then self-calling with user data.
Internal mint that validates and writes _balances and _owners.
Private function performing an external callback to the token receiver contract.
Internal transfer mutating ownership and balance mappings.
Restricted function that instantiates an arbitrary address and forwards state to it.
State setter protected by the flawed restricted modifier.
Returns the current owner used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Private owner mutator emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, relaying and ownership checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used for sale gating and pseudo-randomness.
Native ETH transfer to owner via payable(...).transfer before any accounting.
Low-level address(this).call with attacker-supplied functionSignature and userAddress appended.
External call into IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received allowing receiver reentrancy.
Predictable randomness derived from block.coinbase, block.timestamp and block.difficulty.
Subtractions such as _currentTokenId - 10000 + rand used as ownerOf indices.
Flawed modifier body 'if (msg.sender == owner) _;' that does not revert for non-owners.
Recipient address supplied to the owner-only mint.
New sale start timestamp supplied by the owner.
New base URI string supplied by the owner.
Token id queried for its metadata URI.
Local token id computed from _getNextTokenId before minting.
Local random value (randomHash() % 1000) used as an index offset.
Local hash of lottery participant owners used to pick teslaOwner.

edges.reason: The time parameter is written directly into the startTime state variable.
set_start_time assigns the caller supplied time to startTime.
set_start_time is guarded by onlyOwner which reads Ownable.owner.
startTime is initialized from block.timestamp, a miner-influenced value.
buy gates minting on the block.timestamp comparison with startTime.
buy reads startTime to decide whether the sale is open.
buy requires msg.value to equal the NFT_price state variable.
buy checks _currentTokenId against MAX_SUPPLY.
buy reads the _currentTokenId supply counter.
buy calls _getNextTokenId to compute the new token id.
_getNextTokenId reads _currentTokenId and adds one.
buy invokes ERC721._mint to create the token.
The buyer msg.sender becomes the recipient of the minted token.
msg.sender is the caller that pays for and drives buy.
buy calls _incrementTokenId after minting.
The local newTokenId is passed into _mint.
_getNextTokenId return value is stored in the newTokenId local.
Owner-only mintTo can mint tokens to any address via _mint.
mintTo is guarded by onlyOwner which reads Ownable.owner.
The _to parameter is the recipient used by _mint.
mintTo reads the _currentTokenId supply counter.
mintTo calls _incrementTokenId after minting.
withdraw performs a native ETH transfer to the owner, allowing a fallback reentrancy.
withdraw resolves the recipient through Ownable.owner under onlyOwner.
msg.sender must match the owner for the withdraw transfer to execute.
randomHash mixes block.timestamp into its pseudo-random entropy.
randomHash produces predictable entropy from timestamp, coinbase and difficulty.
_incrementTokenId calls randomHash when the supply is nearly sold out.
_incrementTokenId increments and compares the _currentTokenId counter.
_incrementTokenId computes indices like _currentTokenId - 10000 + rand.
The local rand offset feeds directly into the index arithmetic.
rand influences the hash that finally selects the teslaOwner.
The local txHash modulus determines the written teslaOwner address.
_incrementTokenId writes the lottery result into teslaOwner.
setBaseUri overwrites the baseTokenURI state variable.
The _uri parameter is stored into baseTokenURI.
tokenURI reads baseTokenURI when building the metadata string.
The _tokenId parameter is stringified inside tokenURI.
_msgSender falls back to msg.sender through ContextMixin.msgSender.
executeMetaTransaction performs address(this).call with attacker-controlled calldata.
executeMetaTransaction increments the nonces mapping for the user.
The relayer msg.sender is payable and receives the MetaTransactionExecuted event.
_checkOnERC721Received performs a callback into the receiver contract.
Transfer paths reach the receiver check through _transfer/_safeTransfer flow.
upgrade instantiates an arbitrary address and calls setCompleted on it.
The caller msg.sender is compared against owner in the update chain.
The flawed restricted modifier lets non-owners reach upgrade without reverting.
_setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the _owner state variable used by access checks.
_mint increments the _balances mapping for the recipient.
_mint assigns the new token id in the _owners mapping.
